item.title: The New Version of Come from Away Is Still Wonderful, But a Little Weird
item.description: Perhaps a 10-Year-Old Show Doesn’t Need to Be Changed by Nathalie Graham Here is the thing about Come from Away: you really can’t mess it up. The 2015 musical about the 38 planes diverted from the US airspace during 9/11 and the 7,000 people stranded in the bumfuck nowhere town of Gander, Newfoundland, is wonderful.
